c.responsibility: Design an enterprise data grid with 100,000 rows, 50 columns, sorting, filtering, selection and inline editing. The server supports paged queries and versioned writes. Explain which work is local versus remote and preserve keyboard navigation.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: 100,000 × 50 cells; target around 40 mounted rows and 12 mounted columns including overscan.
c.accessibility: Use table semantics for read-only data; interactive grid needs roving tabIndex, arrow/Home/End navigation, correct logical row/column indices and a focused-cell strategy across virtualization.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Virtualize two axes with stable IDs and bounded overscan; offscreen data and selected IDs are independent of DOM rows. Server sorts/filters the entire dataset. A worker can format/index only loaded data; it cannot make sorting one cached page equivalent to sorting all rows. Alternative: Simple server-paginated tables are cheaper and often more accessible. Full grid behavior is justified by editing and spreadsheet-like navigation.
